title: Cases where Older Workers in PWM Sectors Suffer Demotion and Salary Cuts for Failing to Pass Required Tests due to Language Literacy Gaps
what_it_is: Cases where Older Workers in PWM Sectors Suffer Demotion and Salary Cuts for Failing to Pass Required Tests due to Language Literacy Gaps

sections.label: PWM wages and training requirements
sections.summary: PWM wages are based on the job performed, so employers must pay the applicable wage even if training requirements are unmet.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: While there are training requirements for each job rung, PWM wages are based on the job that the employee is performing and not the completion of training requirements.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: An employer must, therefore, pay an employee the applicable PWM wage even if the employee has not yet met the PWM training requirements, as long as the employee is performing the job.

sections.label: Support for PWM training requirements
sections.summary: Training providers can use vernacular and visual aids and assessment-only pathways, and no feedback on demotions or salary cuts has been received.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Tripartite Partners are mindful that training requirements which are meant to uplift lower-wage workers should not end up disadvantaging them.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: To support the training of workers who may have lower literacy skills or face language barriers, training providers can supplement the delivery of PWM training courses with vernacular and/or visual aids.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Where feasible, some PWM training requirements can also be met through assessment-only pathways.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: These pathways allow experienced employees to meet the PWM training requirements by completing assessments – and typically, these are done in person – to show that they have the requisite skills, without having to attend the course.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: To date, the Ministry of Manpower (MOM), SkillsFuture Singapore (SSG), as well as the respective lead sector agencies of the PWMs for the Cleaning, Security and Landscape sectors have not received feedback about demotions or salary cuts due to failing to pass PWM training requirements.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Manpower (Mr Zaqy Mohamad) (for the Minister for Manpower)
sentences.text: Employees who face challenges in completing PWM training requirements due to language or literacy limitations may approach SSG for further assistance.
